structured_output.what_is_happening: A Solana token called "Concrete" (CT) is trading on PumpSwap. It launched through Meteora's virtual curve and was 37 minutes old at detection, with about $4.3M volume in its first hour. It uses the name and ticker of Concrete (@ConcreteXYZ, Blueprint Finance), a real DeFi vault protocol. On 2026-09-18 that project announced its CT governance token as an ERC-20 on Ethereum, with TGE details 'to be announced separately' and 'no claims, presales, or early access programs'. The packet lists at least 8 other Solana 'CT' tokens named 'Concrete' or 'City Protocol' created over the past ~2 days. All but one now show $0–$10 liquidity with leftover paper market caps, which looks like a series of launch-and-pull cycles. The one exception, a City Protocol copy (HW9K), is live right now with $6.7M hourly volume, following the same pattern. This token looks like the latest in that series.

narrative.description: Impersonation of the real Concrete protocol's recently announced CT governance token (ERC-20, TGE not yet held).
narrative.why_spreading: The real Concrete CT announcement (Sept 18) plus airdrop/TGE interest creates search demand for 'CT' contracts. Scammers can take advantage of that confusion. The flows (1,766 unique buyers vs 163 sellers, a buy/sell ratio of about 2:1) look more like farmed or bot activity than organic discovery.

token_connection.why_this_token: No link to the real project. Official CT is an ERC-20 on Ethereum with no TGE yet, and the project states there are no claims or early access. Neither the ConcreteXYZ X account nor any news source mentions a Solana contract. The GeckoTerminal twitter handle points to ConcreteXYZ, but anyone can add that metadata.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are at least 8 same-name or same-ticker Solana copies from the last ~2 days (Concrete: 4gZd…, 6iNF…, 2xt7…, 5WtW…; City Protocol: E84F…, Bqxk…, 3TrS…, 4i7b…). All are at roughly $0 liquidity. The live City Protocol copy HW9K… has $310k liquidity. The real CT is on Ethereum.

authenticity.evidence: Serial clones with identical names or tickers go to about $0 liquidity within hours. One wallet (FhVo3…) holds 80% of supply. RugCheck flags 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked' (danger) and 'Low amount of LP Providers'. Buyers heavily outnumber sellers (1,766 vs 163), and the creator's other-token count is inconsistent between sources (RugCheck 0 vs a dev X account with 37 launches).
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts directly or the on-chain history of the earlier clones. Their near-zero liquidity could come from a pattern other than LP pulls, but it is consistent with LP pulls.

structural_risks: One non-pool wallet holds 80% of supply and can dump into the $370k pool
Same template as ~8 earlier copies that now show about $0 liquidity
Creator status 'creator_close'; dev's X account has launched 37 tokens

structured_output.counterargument: Volume and liquidity are large ($370k liquidity, 1.7k+ unique buyers). The real Concrete TGE hype is live, so confused buyers could keep flowing in, and the currently live City Protocol copy shows these clones can run for a while. A 2x from $1.17M is possible if the operator wants to inflate the price before pulling. Also, GMGN reports lp_burn_ratio 1.0, which conflicts with RugCheck's unlocked-LP warning.
unknowns: Whether the 80% wallet is a pool or vault account that was mislabeled
How the earlier clones actually died (LP pull vs dump)
Any X posts promoting this contract
Whether the real Concrete TGE is imminent

source_coverage.notes: News confirms the real CT is an ERC-20 on Ethereum with TGE TBA. Searching the contract address found nothing. The site:x.com search found only official ConcreteXYZ posts, with no Solana CT contract. DexScreener returned 403. I did not search Reddit, Telegram or Discord (below the minimum coverage), because the impersonation evidence was already decisive.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a copy-cat token riding the name of the real Concrete CT (an Ethereum token whose TGE hasn't happened), made from the same template as about 8 earlier Solana copies that now show about $0 liquidity. With 80% of supply in one wallet and the LP unlocked, a liquidity pull or dump within 6 hours is the most likely outcome. A 2x from entry before that is unlikely.
